## English

This directory contains architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel — news3400/fb.

`config.mk` records 7 source file(s) here: `askrom.c`, `fb_conf.c`, `fb_mfbs.c`, `fb_probe.c`, `fb_start.c`, `fbbm_253.c`, `fbbm_lcdm.c`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
